impacts.label: Delayed or spoiled shipments to your customers
impacts.description: When your computers or equipment go down, loads sit at the dock, trucks cannot be dispatched, or cold goods warm up. Your customers get late or ruined product.

impacts.label: Fraudulent invoices sent to partners in your name
impacts.description: Criminals use your email or accounts to send fake invoices or bank-change requests to your customers and suppliers. They pay because it looks like it came from you.

impacts.label: Attackers reaching partners through shared systems
impacts.description: Shared portals, vendor connections, and email threads let an attacker who gets into your business move on into a partner's systems.

impacts.label: Customers' loads stolen or delivered to bad actors
impacts.description: A redirected or double-brokered load never reaches the grocer or processor waiting for it. They lose the product and the shelf space, and they remember whose truck it was.

impacts.label: Failed customer security audit
impacts.description: Grocers, processors, and shippers increasingly send suppliers security questionnaires. Gaps like these can fail them and put contracts at risk.

impacts.label: Partner and customer data exposed
impacts.description: Information partners trusted you with, like rates, contacts, or payment details, ends up in the wrong hands.
